description: In crl.rs, parse_issuing_dp() silently ignores DER decode failures on IssuingDistributionPoint (PKIX-fy1b.3 tracks fixing it). Independently, there is no test in crl_checker_tests.rs that exercises a CRL with a present-but-malformed IDP extension, so the current fail-open behavior is not observable in the test suite. Even after PKIX-fy1b.3 fixes the fail-open, a regression test with a malformed-IDP fixture would prevent the fix from being reverted.
title: Missing test for CrlChecker where IssuingDistributionPoint has malformed DER — current fail-open is untested
